verdict.rationale: Requesty's analytics dashboard docs confirm tracking of costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency in real-time, which covers most of the story, but there is no evidence of inspecting individual logged request/response payload content (bodies) rather than aggregate metrics. missing for 10: evidence of per-request log inspection with full request/response bodies, screenshots or independent corroboration of the dashboard UI, and confirmation of per-call cost/latency drill-down rather than aggregate analytics.
